3. Vide order dated 24.02.2025, the present 
revision was admitted and LCR was ordered to 
be summoned. 
4. Today, it has come to the notice of this 
Court that in the original physical order-sheet
of that date, the portion of the order relating 
to summoning of the LCR, was inadvertently 
omitted, whereas, in the uploaded order, it 
has been mentioned. Be that as it may, it 
appears that the omission occurred due to 
some typographical error, which was 
inadvertent.
5. Accordingly, the revision stands 
admitted. Let the Lower Court Record be 
summoned. List immediately after receipt of 
the LCR.
